categories.reasoning: Six consultations (con-staff-workshop, con-member-interviews, con-funder-interview, con-assembly, con-measurement-workshop, con-problem-tree-review) cover focus, change analysis, assumptions and measurement with named groups, and changedIds show effect. But residents of low-access areas (tg-low-access-residents, act-residents, stance unknown), the least-heard group, were not consulted and the absence is not acknowledged; the county office and library are also not consulted.

Lint IMP-LOG-001/002 are GO: every link carries a rationale and assumption (e.g. ln-cohorts-skills). Precondition groups state logic and sufficiency: grp-capable (all), grp-collab (at_least 2, marked hypothesis), grp-voice (all). The reinforcing loop ln-collab-recruit is explicit.

context.rootCauses and the cause tree trace immediate causes (cause-no-peer-exchange, cause-high-overhead) to underlying (cause-isolation) and structural (cause-no-standing-voice) causes. IMP-CAU-001 is GO. cause-funding-volatility is set aside with a reason in outOfScope.

Critical and high assumptions (asm-skills-applied, asm-members-deliver, asm-time-to-attend, asm-vendor-terms, asm-officials-receptive, asm-positions-hold) have types, criticality and tests (IMP-ASM-001/004 GO). Risks rsk-time-burden, rsk-large-dominate, rsk-funder-shift etc. have mitigations and relatedAssumptionIds. Context and partner assumptions appear (asm-peer-trust, asm-officials-receptive). Evidence gaps on two assumptions are covered under evidence.

All interventions have owners (IMP-INT-002 GO); pathways pw-learning/shared/civic name ownerActorId; shared outcome oc-resident-access lists deliveredBy. Partners with stance and influence are identified (act-county-office, act-members-large, act-regional-funder, act-city-council stance unknown).

Most links and assumptions cite followable evidence (ev-peer-learning, ev-pooled-purchasing, ev-county-services), and the contradicting ev-collab-study is acknowledged. However IMP-ASM-002 flags asm-officials-receptive and asm-positions-hold as high-criticality with no evidence; asm-officials-receptive is marked stated yet its provenance cites ev-funder-interview, a funder interview that does not concern county planning staff, so its basis looks overstated. Restricted ev-funder-interview is not penalised. Gaps are listed in the assessment.

Target groups tg-small-members and tg-low-access-residents are named and oc-resident-access targets the latter. But IMP-EQU-001 warns that no indicator breaks results down by tg-low-access-residents (ind-residents-served is split by neighborhood and age group only), so results are not broken down by the group.

A Mermaid pathway diagram, per-pathway diagrams and logic models, a plain-language narrative (context.narrative, assessment) and a glossary (term-output, term-outcome) all exist and agree with the model. Audiences are defined.

Pathways follow well-evidenced mechanisms (cohorts plus coaching, ev-peer-learning; pooled purchasing, ev-pooled-purchasing), lags are stated on links (e.g. ln-cohorts-skills P3M), the 2026-2028 horizon is realistic, and weak spots are honest (grp-collab and asm-positions-hold as hypothesis, plausibility low).

ceilingOfAccountability is long_term with rationale; resident impacts are tracked, not owned (IMP-ACC-001/002 GO). Resources are examined: rsk-staff-capacity (8 staff, three programs), open dec-liaison-staff, measurementBudget fits (IMP-BUD-001/002 GO), and dec-certification dropped an over-reach.

Lint IMP-MEA-002 warns of 4 indicators missing baseline, target or data source (ind-story-peer-help, ind-service-deals, ind-calendar-current, ind-briefings), and the assessment lists four outcomes within accountability with no indicator: oc-lt-capable-members, oc-im-peer-network, oc-st-calendar-use, oc-st-channel. IMP-MET-003 also warns the pw-learning roll-up cannot be computed. Most other indicators have baselines, targets, sources and frequencies.

Lint reports no errors but four unexplained WARN rules: IMP-ASM-002 (asm-officials-receptive, asm-positions-hold), IMP-EQU-001 (oc-resident-access), IMP-MEA-002 (4 findings), IMP-MET-003 (pw-learning, met-enrollments). The document does not explain them, so not GO.

findings.title: Residents of low-access areas not consulted
findings.description: tg-low-access-residents / act-residents were never consulted and the absence is not acknowledged.
findings.recommendation: Consult residents or record why they were not and plan to.

findings.title: Outcomes within accountability lack indicators and baselines
findings.description: oc-lt-capable-members, oc-im-peer-network, oc-st-calendar-use, oc-st-channel have no indicator; ind-story-peer-help, ind-service-deals, ind-calendar-current, ind-briefings lack baseline/target (IMP-MEA-002).
findings.recommendation: Add indicators, baselines and targets; add the weight metric for pw-learning (IMP-MET-003).

findings.title: Evidence basis overstated for high assumptions
findings.description: asm-officials-receptive is marked stated but cites a funder interview rather than evidence about county planning staff; asm-positions-hold cites none (IMP-ASM-002).
findings.recommendation: Cite relevant evidence or re-mark as inferred/hypothesis.

decision.rationale: Four required categories (process, evidence, testable, structural_integrity) are partial, with three medium findings to fix before approval; logic, causes, actors, plausibility and feasibility are strong.
